title: Use the Liquor Licence Manager
summary: Use the Liquor Licence Manager online service to manage your liquor licence.
intro: The Liquor Licence Manager is an online service where you can:
who_can_apply: Be at least 18 years of age
Hold a NSW Liquor Licence and be listed as a premises owner, business owner, spouse or family member, or legal representative.
Act on behalf of the licensee as one of the following: premises owner, business owner, spouse or family member, or legal representative.
what_you_need: Personal details of the licensee (for individuals)
ABN, ACN, or Y/Inc of the licensee (for organisations)
The representative's name and contact details (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Log in using an existing MyServiceNSW Account or follow the prompts to create a new account.

more_info.text: You can contact Liquor & Gaming NSW at liquorlicencemanager@liquorandgaming.nsw.gov.au for more information.
